articles.title: AMC Theaters Is Broadcasting the 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals at Select Cinemas Across the US
articles.summary: The 2026 Rocket League World Championship Finals will be broadcast at 50 AMC Theaters across the United States. The Finals take place on Sunday, September 20. That day, fans can show up to participating AMC Theaters nationwide and catch the action on the big screen.
body: The competition will stream live from Dickies Arena in Fort Worth, Texas, where 20 teams will throw down for the chance to win $300,000 out of a staggering $1.2 million prize pool. The total broadcast will last approximately eight hours.

Tickets are currently on sale at participating theaters, with adult tickets priced at $19.49 ($22.18 if booked online). Only a few of these theaters are showing the Finals, and tickets are selling out fast, so make sure to grab yours quickly if you want a front row seat to see who gets crowned the 15th Rocket League World Champions.

Most major esports tournaments are streamed on Twitch, with viewers receiving special drops that can be earned by simply watching on the platform. AMC Theaters has already thought of this, and is giving fans commemorative Rocket League tickets that include codes to redeem the drops that they would normally get watching the competition on Twitch.

articles.title: SteelSeries Aeon Pro Review So Far
articles.summary: The SteelSeries Aeon Pro is one of the most advanced controllers I've ever tested. It's also the most expensive – but it brings some features never before seen in a controller.
body: Notably, the Aeon Pro borrows the outstanding "infinite battery" system from the SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro line of gaming headsets. Instead of relying on a cable or dock to charge the controller, the Aeon Pro has two rechargeable batteries – one in the controller and another that charges in the base station. Like the Nova Pro, when one battery runs out of juice, you simply pop it out and swap it with the fully-charged one from the base station. In less than 10 seconds, your controller is fully juiced up and the previously depleted battery is tucked back in the dock to charge.

I'm a big believer in this "infinite" battery system. It's one of the most revolutionary features to come to gaming headsets and is the reason I continue to recommend the Arctis Nova Pro, so I'm thrilled to see SteelSeries implement it in a controller. Even better, the base station also serves as a dock for the controller, giving it a home to live on your desk or entertainment center when not in use.
points: The SteelSeries Aeon Pro is one of the most advanced controllers I've ever tested.
It's also the most expensive – but it brings some features never before seen in a controller.

articles.title: Xbox Game Pass Adds A Great Call Of Duty Game Today
articles.summary: Xbox Game Pass grows today with the addition of a popular Call of Duty game. New to the service from today, September 8, is 2020's Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It's available on Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, and PC Game Pass, and the game supports cloud streaming as well.
body: Developed by Treyarch and Raven, Black Ops Cold War is set in Cold War-era 1981, with its campaign following Russell Adler as he and his team seek out a spy named Perseus. The game also has multiplayer, of course, along with Zombies.
Black Ops Cold War was a bit hit, becoming 2020's best-selling game overall in the US.
Game Pass isn't done adding more titles this month, as The Royal Writ and Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O World Stage arrive on September 10, followed by RuneScape: Dragonwilds on September 15.

After Microsoft bought Activision Blizzard, many assumed that back-catalog Call of Duty games would flood Game Pass, but that didn't happen. Instead of releasing Call of Duty games en masse to Game Pass, Microsoft has taken more of a selective approach. Black Ops Cold War is now just the sixth Call of Duty game on Game Pass, joining Call of Duty: WWII, Call of Duty: Vanguard, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Black Ops 6.

articles.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Is Finally Getting a 4K Blu-ray Release Ahead of Season 3
articles.summary: The Rings of Power is finally getting a 4K Blu-ray release. The Prime Video series inspired by J.R.R. Tolkien’s The Lord of The Rings has been a streaming exclusive since it first premiered back in 2022.
body: All of the DVD releases are now available to preorder ahead of their release dates in November and December, which will roughly coincide with the release of the show’s third season.

Both seasons of The Rings of Power are getting the same general breakdown of DVD releases. Your options, listed in order from the cheapest to the most expensive, are a standard DVD ($39.99), Blu-ray ($46.99), and 4K ($51.99), as well as Amazon-exclusive limited-edition 4K steelbooks ($61.99). The standard DVDs for both seasons will all be released on November 3, while the limited-edition steelbooks won’t ship until December 1.
The standard DVDs for Season 1 all feature the same cover art. You get a look at most of the main cast, though the focus is on Galadriel against the bright white background.

The 4K steelbook for this one has some fantastic old-school fantasy vibes, coming in a gold slipcase with frames images of Galadriel on the front and the Great Tree on the back. The steelbook also comes with six collectible art cards, each featuring some ethereal photographed portraits of individual characters.
points: The Rings of Power is finally getting a 4K Blu-ray release.

articles.title: The Bomb Busters Board Game Drops to Its Lowest Price Ever at Amazon
articles.summary: Bomb Busters is now 30% off at Amazon for a limited time, which is the lowest price we've ever seen on the cooperative board game. It has been just over a year since this game was named the 2025 Spiel des Jahres in Germany, the highest honor in board games.
body: For those not familiar with the German "Game of the Year" award, it's a pretty big deal in the tabletop community. After news of its win broke, the game sold out pretty much everywhere in North America. If you don't already have it in your collection, this discount makes it a great time to pick it up.

As for what type of game Bomb Busters actually is, you can look to the name for answers. It's a strategic cooperative board game that sees 2-5 players attempting to diffuse a bomb and cut the correct wires. There are a total of 66 different missions included, with increasing levels of difficulty. If you've ever played the video game Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes, you should have an idea of what to expect.

All-in-all what makes Bomb Busters great is that it's something anyone can play. It's a great board game for families or to pull out with a small gathering of friends. Typical games will only take around 30 minutes to play, so you can quickly work together to diffuse a bomb and then move onto something else if you want.

articles.title: 5 Great Movies Brad Bird Says to Watch Before Netflix's 'Ray Gunn'
articles.summary: Brad Bird ( Ratatouille, The Incredibles ) describes his next movie, Ray Gunn, as The Maltese Falcon meets Buck Rogers. He’s spent nearly 30 years trying to make this unusual mashup of hard-boiled detective story and pulp science fiction.
body: “I like the contradiction of things that are considered very modern and futuristic, but having it look like a person 70 years ago imagined the future,” Bird told Polygon during an interview at the Annecy Film Festival.

That alternate future involves jetpacks, flying cars, aliens, and Art Deco skyscrapers. Machines now handle most detective work, but Ray Gunn (Sam Rockwell) is still working as a private investigator in the massive city of Metropia. His latest case involves helping the pop star Venus Nova (Scarlett Johansson) deal with a scandal that endangers her career and even her life. It’s edgier than Bird's Pixar work, driven by a deep love for noir and its themes, which he says will “never go out of style.”
If you want to see some of his inspirations, here are five films Bird recommends watching before Ray Gunn premieres on Netflix on Dec. 18.

articles.title: Xbox’s Disc-To-Digital Program Has A Big Problem: Several Major Publishers Aren’t Participating
articles.summary: Xbox's disc-to-digital program looks like it could be a vital step forward for players who want to hold on to their physical games in an increasingly digital world, but it does have limits.
body: So far, it looks like games from Sega, Square Enix, Ubisoft, and Bandai Namco are largely incompatible with the disc-to-digital service. As verified by Kotaku, popping in a disc for a game from one of those publishers could result in a "not participating in digital licensing" message. A fan effort to catalogue all the games that do work with it also shows which titles from those publishers are incompatible with disc-to-digital, so if you were holding on to a physical edition of Far Cry 4, Final Fantasy 15, or Dark Souls 3, you're out of luck.

This is something that Square Enix has been called to task over, as several of its big HD-2D RPGs have no upgrade path to Switch 2. For example, if you purchased Octopath Traveler for the Switch, there's no complimentary or premium upgrade pack to give it sharper graphics and new features on a Switch 2 console. Instead, you'll have to buy the game again when its Switch 2 version launches, and you don't even get an option to transfer your save game over.
points: Xbox's disc-to-digital program looks like it could be a vital step forward for players who want to hold on to their physical games in an increasingly digital world, but it does have limits.

articles.title: 20 best board wipes in Magic: The Gathering
articles.summary: While early sweepers simply destroyed everything in sight, decades of card design have led to a fascinating variety of board wipe functionality. Modern alternatives often bypass indestructible keywords and death triggers using non-targeting exile effects or mass toughness penalties like -X/-X.
body: In Magic: The Gathering, board wipes (otherwise known as "sweepers") serve as the ultimate reset button. Whether you’re in a pinch with no creatures while your opponents have full armies, or you’re looking to slow the game down by ridding everyone of lands, these are the types of spells designed to clear multiple cards from the battlefield in a single shot. These kinds of big plays have been a pillar of Magic strategy since the game’s debut in 1993, when Alpha introduced Wrath of God and set the standard for mass destruction. Control and midrange decks rely heavily on these cards to erase an opponent's early momentum, using one card from your hand to level an entire battlefield of threats.

Whether you’re looking to survive a high-stakes 1v1 format or turn the tides in a chaotic four-player Commander pod, having the right sweeper in your deck is crucial. Presented in no particular order, here are 20 of the absolute best board wipes in MTG history, each bringing its own unique brand of devastation to the battlefield.

articles.title: GameStop Sets A New Financial Record, And It’s No Thanks To Games
articles.summary: Retailer GameStop has released its latest earnings report, and it was a record-breaker for the company. The Texas-based retailer's biggest number for its fiscal Q2 quarter that ended August 1 was $160.2 million.
body: Net income was up, too, reaching $298.7 million, compared to $168.6 million last year.

GameStop benefitted from continued growth in its biggest sales category--collectibles--which saw net sales jump a whopping 57% year-over-year to $356.3 million. For this latest period, collectibles made up 45.1% of GameStop's net sales.

GameStop was once primarily known as a video game retailer, and while it still sells games, consoles, and accessories, the company's biggest revenue-driver today is collectibles. Anyone who has walked into a GameStop store recently can attest to how much shelf space is dedicated to collectibles.

GameStop's next-largest revenue-driver was its "video game" category, which reached $263.2 million for the period, down sharply from $494.6 million during the same period last year that benefitted from the Switch 2 launch. Finally, GameStop's pre-owned and refurbished business made up $170.7 million during the period, down from $250 million last year.
points: Retailer GameStop has released its latest earnings report, and it was a record-breaker for the company.

articles.title: South Park Creators Reveal Official New Name for South Park
articles.summary: South Park 's creators are officially renaming South Park after three decades — but how long that name will stick remains to be seen. On Tuesday, show creators Trey Parker and Matt Stone revealed the new name of South Park in the duo's latest attack on U.S.
body: “Inspired by the bravery and patriotism of Apple and Google, we are changing the name of South Park to SOUTH AMERICA. We especially want to thank our parent company Paramount — a Skydance Capitulation,” Parker and Stone said in an official announcement.

The South Park creators are poking fun at Trump's executive orders that renamed the Gulf of Mexico to the Gulf of America and Lake Ontario to Lake America. Tech companies like Apple and Google quickly reacted to those orders, updating the names of each body of water on Apple Maps and Google Maps, respectively. Trump has also posted about renaming the state of New Mexico to New America, which he has no legal authority to do, but which Silicon Valley sycophants would embrace with great cowardice to curry favor with the current president.
Trump has been a big target for South Park in recent years. In Seasons 27 and 28 of the animated comedy, Trump is shown having sex with (and impregnating) Satan. Trump's flaccid penis is also shown.

articles.summary: Last week at IFA 2026 TP-Link announced two new Wi-Fi 8 routers —the Archer 9 Ultra and the Deco 8 Ultra—though the actual price and release date aren’t yet known, other than availability being later this year.
body: While TP-Link claimed these are the first Wi-Fi 8 routers to be revealed, this isn't quite the case: Asus showed off its Wi-Fi 8 ROG Rapture GT-BN98 at Computex in June, and we were there having a proper gawk. This is a premium gaming router that’s loaded up with features and game optimisations, and with classic completely-OTT ROG looks.

Asus also showed its more mainstream ZenWiFi BN12 at Computex for normal people. Pricing and availability have not yet been announced—though review samples of the ROG Rapture GT-BN98 are expected to be available very soon, so it’s not far off.

Wi-Fi 8 isn’t so much about boosting speed over Wi-Fi 7: stability under heavy load is the main objective of the new standard, as we continue to saturate the Wi-Fi airwaves with ever more demanding uses.

articles.title: Corporations want to kill physical media because it suits them, but Big Box PC game packaging just got a second chance
articles.summary: If you were alive and sentient in the nineties you probably harbour some fondness for the "big box" PC games of yore. Back then, rather than buy an ephemeral digital license for a game, you'd head to a store to buy a huge box bedecked in lavish art, inside which you'd find a handful of 3.5-inch…
body: There's been renewed interest in the ye olde big box PC game, especially in the wake of Sony's announcement it will discontinue physical PlayStation games. Some proactive folk have gone viral for manufacturing their own physical Steam games. Now GOG has offered its own alternative: printable big boxes based on scans of real commercial packages from the golden era of game packaging.

In collaboration with Big Box Collection—which is a fan-operated trove of big box 3D scans—GOG is now offering those 3D scans with five entries in its GOG Preservation Program. These include the newly added Star Trek: 25th Anniversary and Armikrog, while games already in the Preservation Program including Descent, Hitman: Codename 47, and Myst will also receive the treatment.

"We’re delivering flat, printable versions of the same box art, so you can cut, fold, and glue your own physical big box at home," reads GOG's announcement. "A proper papercraft project for anyone who misses shelves full of PC game boxes."

articles.title: "Dawg it's Unreal Engine Zelda" - Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake's new looks receives a mixed reception online following reveal
articles.summary: With the gameplay reveal of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake happening earlier today, thousands of people from around of the world have taken their first look at the latest entry in the beloved Nintendo series. The most immediate reaction from the masses?
body: The game has been created with a modern new aesthetic, one that appears to be striking the balance between the iconic original and modern tools at Nintendo's disposal. The result is a game that looks familiar but different, with highly details landscapes and faces. Link, especially, has an interesting look to him.
It's worth noting up front that there's a lot of positively surrounding the reveal. Multiple fans of the original have taken to social media to express their delight.

Nintendo's remakes look like what the original artists wanted to make, but couldn't because of the limitations of the era. Personally, I like it. It feels like playing with the promo art from strategy guides and magazine spreads. But it also means these new remakes look anachronistic in 2026.
However, these positive sentiments are matched by many detractors, some of whom making a connection between this new reveal and the Unreal Engine Nintendo joke mock-ups from the past.
